notes.title: Achievement Unlocked
notes.content: We have now added a few achievements for you to unlock. Can you get them all? We may add more achievements in the future, but these ones we wanted to add as core achievements of the game. Have fun collecting!

notes.title: Mac Build Added !
notes.content: For all my Mac users out there, you can now play Woodheart! Please let us know if you have any issues and we hope you enjoy exploring the world of Irel!
